summary: Comprehensive testing of System Status Dashboard and Device Online Status features for Kirmes Billing System. All backend APIs tested and working (18/18 tests passed). Frontend UI verified - System Status Dashboard shows MongoDB, users, devices, generators with auto-refresh. Device Management table shows 'Verbindung' column with online status indicators.
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - existing devices and users used for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: System Status Dashboard and Device Online Status features fully tested. Backend endpoint GET /api/system/status returns mongodb.connected, users count, devices (total/active/online), generators (total/online), recent_activity.emu_records_last_hour. Device list endpoint GET /api/devices enriches stromerzeuger/lichtmast devices with last_seen from generators collection. Frontend shows System-Status section at top of Admin Settings page with 4 status cards. Device Management table has 'VERBINDUNG' column showing online status dots (green=online, amber=idle, red=offline, gray=never connected) with last_seen time. All 7 devices currently show gray dots with '-' since no IoT data has been ingested recently - this is expected behavior.

backend_apis.description: Returns system status with mongodb.connected, users, devices (total/active/online), generators (total/online), recent_activity, timestamp, collections count
Returns device list with last_seen field enriched from generators collection for stromerzeuger/lichtmast types
